description: This file is a shell script for testing Git's atomic push functionality, including setup, various push scenarios, hooks, and failure conditions.

methods.name: mk_repo_pair
methods.description: Creates a pair of repositories 'upstream' and 'workbench' for testing, configuring 'upstream' to warn on current branch and adding 'upstream' as a remote in 'workbench'.

methods.name: test_refs
methods.description: Compares the verified revision of a given ref in the upstream repository with that in the workbench repository to ensure synchronization.

methods.name: fmt_status_report
methods.description: Formats the output from git push to show only relevant status lines.
